notes.title: Version Update
notes.content: [p]\[Version Update][/p][p]New and optimized content after the update on Sep. 17:[/p][p]1. Home Decor Platform[/p][p]Ever seen a stunning home from a top designer and wished you could move right in? Or maybe you've found the perfect floor plan but lack the creative touch to bring it to life? Those days are over! Introducing the all-new Home Decor Platform![/p][p]\[Export Design as Template]: One-click home export - save your masterpiece and never lose it again! You can now export you current home's decorations, furniture, landform, and all construction elements as you own exclusive template. Later, you can import this template into any compatible property, making it easy to recreate your designs anytime![/p][p]\[Home Decor Platform]: Browse countless designs and learn from the best! To help you share your creative home design inspiration, we're excited to introduce the Home Decor Platform![/p][p]\[Upload Design to Platform]: Show off your creativity and earn those likes! Design prodigies can upload their templates to the Home Decor Platform for others to view. You can even set custom permissions for viewing and usage, allowing others to visit and learn from your designs or apply them to their own homes![/p][p]\[Import Design to Home]: Love what you see? Import instantly and move into that dream home! Decorating rookies can browse others' designs on the Home Design Platform, discovering inspiring content and learning valuable construction techniques. You can even import others' home designs directly into your own property for immediate use, getting that same stunning home as the masters! Once uploaded, all home designs will be tagged with author information. When used by others, directly uploaded, or modified and re-uploaded as new designs, the new template will still credit the original author and source work. Don't forget to show your appreciation with likes, collects, and comments - the ultimate triple combo![/p][p]The Home Decor Platform creates a stage for home construction masters to showcase their talents while giving newcomers the chance to move into luxury homes hassle-free![/p][p]2. Fix Floating/Backwear[/p][p]With the new function located at Wardrobe > Backwear Position, you can place the floating items or back accessories anywhere you like in a photo scene or the Panel, and make them fixed at where they are when your character moves. Make use of the new function and create more stunning views![/p][p]The function will open shortly after the version update. Follow future notice for official open time.[/p][p]3. Pet Height Adjustment[/p][p]After the version update, you can use the newly added Height button at Wardrobe > Change Pet to adjust the pet position at your Wardrobe. Make them appear anywhere at the Wardrobe and add more fun to your styling time![/p][p]4. New Items in Shops[/p][p]In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, Value Rebates, and Trending Shop, new items are added, including 4-Star Necklace \[Love's End], 4-Star Wrist \[New Wood Dew], 4-Star Earrings \[Evernight Star], furniture, cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat bubble, cover chat background, and more. [/p][p]5. Guild Beauty Course Update[/p][p]After the version update, new 4-Star Makeup Set \[Scenery Stroll] and \[Lone Hook] are available in Guild Beauty Course.[/p][p]6. New Story Quest Chapter 34: Forgotten Dusk - Reverie Opens on Sep. 29[/p][p]The bell strikes at dusk, mingling reality and illusion.[/p][p]A wedding coming from the depth of time carries countless memory fragments.[/p][p]On the verge of darkness, the hand of clock starts to rewind,[/p][p]Dragging you into an eternal dream...[/p][p]After the chapter opens, new sets are ready to craft, including 4-star set - Azure Roaming, 4-star set - Sunset Elegy, and 4-star set - Gold Burner Sun.[/p][p]Story Quest Chapter 34 Vvanna Challenge will open too![/p][p]Clear the stage to obtain 5-star hair accessory - Endless Rhythm, pose - Overstepping Mark, photo frame - Nocturne Kiss. 4-star dress - Rime Satin will be available in Vvanna Shop.[/p][p]7. Sign-in Collection - Light's Path[/p][p]Previously available sign-in fashion - Light's Path will be ready to craft on Oct. 1 at Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.[/p][p]Optimizations and Bug Fixes[/p][p]1. You can use "Back" and "Next" at Dye > All Random to switch among whole-body random dyes.[/p][p]2. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture displayed incorrect seam effects on certain body parts when using the Girl body type.[/p][p]3. Fixed an issue in Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture where the nail positioning would be wrongly displayed on the Girl body type.[/p][p]4. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture would occasionally cause facial and body skin tones to appear inconsistent.[/p][p]5. Fixed an issue where Reshape Look 3.0 Realistic Skin Texture would display incorrect connection effects in the Home area.[/p][p]6. Fixed the display error for certain fashions.[/p][p]7. Fixed an issue where facial paint adjustments could not be saved properly during duo photo sessions.[/p][p]8. Fixed an issue where characters would occasionally become immovable or disappear after selecting photo templates during duo photo sessions.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where the face paint display would be wrongly shifted on the fashion previewing interface after previewing poses at the Decom Shop.[/p][p]10. Fixed the issue where oversized images would be improperly cut in Vvanna Community.[/p][p]11. Fixed an issue where the Vvanna Community homepage would occasionally fail to refresh content.[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue where fashions' X Starlight is not synchronized when returning to Panel.[/p][p]13. Fixed incorrect eating animations for certain recipes.[/p][p]14. Fixed incorrect voice acting in certain story stages.[/p]

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content: [p]New content and optimizations after the update on Aug. 27:[/p][p]1. All Random Dye & Settings[/p][p]After the function is open, you can have the system generate a tailored whole-body fashion dye plan! Whether you want a quick transformation for your character or looking for inspirations for dress-matching, the intelligent assistant should be your handy choice for a wardrobe surprise. Try out the new Whole Body Random Dye function and unleash new charm on your road to style![/p][p]Meanwhile, you can select color range for the random dyes. Press and hold the Random Dye button to open the setting interface, where you can select the colors to use for random dyeing - Owned colors only/All Palettes/All Palettes and X Palette. The function will open shortly after the version update. Follow future notice for official open time.[/p][p]2. Original Skin Tone for Reshape Look 3.0[/p][p]With the upcoming function, you can adjust original skin colors and lip colors for Realistic Skins and Refined Lips. From natural glow to refreshing purity, the freedom of customization is completely yours! The function will open shortly after the version update. Follow future notice for official open time.[/p][p]3. Version Theme Song: "Mother Goddess Nuo" [/p][p]New version theme song "Mother Goddess Nuo", inspired by the \[Crimson Cleansing] set, will be available in game as Panel Music! Feel the mysterious Nuo Goddess power in the music![/p][p]4. New Panel Music: Litchi Kitten Meow[/p][p]The new theme song "Litchi Kitten Meow", inspired by the new pet family, has been available in the game as Panel Music! Swing into the loveliness of Litchi Kittens along the beat![/p][p]5. New and Limited Qixi Recipe[/p][p]The limited Qixi Festival recipe is available to celebrate the fine date! From Aug. 29, 05:00 to Sep. 4, 05:00 UTC, limited NPC - Chirpy will show up at your Home with purchasable recipe \[Magpie and Star]. Don't miss out![/p][p]6. Sign-in Collection - Clear Sky Gift[/p][p]Previously available sign-in fashion - Clear Sky Gift will be ready to craft on Sep. 1 at Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.[/p][p]Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.[/p][p]\[Optimizations and Bug Fixes][/p][p]1. Fixed the lagging issue that would occur when purchasing a large amount of Lightchase ticket Value Packs at once.[/p][p]2. Fixed the issue that made certain contacts ineffective when using Realistic Eyes in Reshape Look 3.0.[/p][p]3. Fixed the abnormal seaming issue on certain Realistic Skins in Reshape Look 3.0.[/p][p]4. Fixed the incorrect physical effect display for certain dresses.[/p][p]5. Fixed the clipping issue for certain dresses on custom body types.[/p][p]6. Fixed the abnormal display for certain dresses.[/p][p]7. Fixed the display error when pairing certain hairstyle with hair accessories.[/p][p]8. Fixed the abnormal thumbnail display ratio for cetain wrist accessories.[/p][p]9. Fixed the display error for certain socks in certain circumstances.[/p][p]10. Fixed the wrongly displayed hair braids in certain hat's thumbnail.[/p][p]11. Fixed the inconsistent dye effect on the bows of certain gloves.[/p][p]12. Fixed the inconsistency between certain necklace and its preview image.[/p][p]13. Fixed the clipping model for certain shoes on custom body types.[/p][p]14. Fixed the missing effects of certain contacts on girl's body type.[/p][p]15. Optimized the logic of avatar uploading, fixing the loophole in editing avatars in a non-compliant way.[/p][p]16. Fixed the issue where custom face paint effects would be wrongly displayed after switching image slots.[/p][p]17. Fixed the issue where shared Fashion Diary covers would be displayed in a wrong ratio.[/p][p]18. Fixed certain clipping issues for Litchi Kittens.[/p][p]19. Fixed certain missing entries for Litchi Kittens in the  Compendium.[/p][p]20. Fixed certain errors in story lines.[/p]

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content: [p]New content and optimizations after the update on Aug. 6:[/p][p]1. Reshape Look 3.0 [/p][p]Reshape Look 3.0 ushers in a new era of beauty in Life Makeover![/p][p]Comprehensive skin texture upgrade, enhanced Subsurface Scattering (SSS) effect bringing you refined SSS model, visible refined pores and veins, and vivid skin texture ready to make your customization more lifelike.[/p][p]Meanwhile, there will be comprehensive eye area and lip detail improvements. Refined scleral vein texture and delicate lip texture will surely bring more depth to your features. [/p][p]Additionally, you'll be able to edit Face Paints! From position and shade to size and rotation, all the Face Paints will be editable, making your cosmetic combination even more attractive.[/p][p]Moreover, you'll get more customization options, from mouth width to eye distance, fine-tuning every facial and body details for your characters. Three darker skin tones and three paler ones will be added in your skin color choices too. [/p][p]That's not all, we'll bring a collection of handy editing tools for you too, including demo poses, camera-focusing, and tap-to-remove, helping you to find the look you want faster and appreciate your visual masterpiece better![/p][p]2. Fashion Random Dye[/p][p]After the function opens, you can tap the Random Dye button on fashion piece dyeing interface to have the system generate a fashionable and unique dye plan for you. When in need of inspiration, try letting the intelligent system navigate you to wardrobe surprises and perhaps the destined color scheme is just around the corner.[/p][p]3. Highlight Dye Areas Coming Soon[/p][p]After the function opens, when you select new dye areas that are regular dye areas, you will be able to see them highlighted in different colors, shimmering for several seconds. This aims to help you better distinguish different dye areas when you dye fashions.[/p][p]Dye areas for fashion effects will be marked differently in Dye/X Palette/X Starlight interfaces.[/p][p]4. All/Multiple Dye Area Selecting[/p][p]After the function opens, All-Area and Multi-Area options will be available in Dye/X Palette/X Starlight interfaces:[/p][p]Use All-Area Mode to recolor all dye areas, and use Multi-Area Mode to recolor multiple areas at the same time.[/p][p]5. Story Qurest Chapter 33: Liar's Game - Twist Opens on Aug. 18[/p][p]What lies behind the gate? What secrets are hidden within its mind? [/p][p]When the last neural connection breaks and the flood surges in, how many will remain standing until the end...[/p][p]New sets in the Fashion Studio will come along with this chapter: 5-Star Set - Sunlit Rose, 4-Star Set - Morning Waltz, and 4-Star Set - Night Loner.[/p][p]Meanwhile, Vvanna Challenge Chapter 33 will open too![/p][p]Clear the stage for 5-Star Wrist Accessory - Roman Heart, Pose - Leaf Trace, Photo Frame - Sand Touch, and more. 4-Star Dress - Radiance Curtain is added in Vvanna Shop.[/p][p]6. Photo Template Share [/p][p]While admiring the stunning photo templates, do you feel it can be even better if you can share the template to more? The Photo Template Sharing Code will answer your call! You can share your painstakingly created photo templates to your friends, allowing them to apply the composition and assets quickly. Permission settings will be available as well, so that sharing does not come at the price of privacy.[/p][p]7. New Arrivals in Rebate Shops[/p][p]In Special Rebates, new 5-star necklace \[The Vicissitudes] and 5-star earrings \[Red Cherry Verse] are added. In Super Rebates, new 5-star hairstyle \[Litchi Sliding] is added. In Deluxe Rebates, new 5-star dress \[Inkflow Radiance] is added. Moreover, new items including cute effect, chat bubble, title, and more are available in Rebate Shops.[/p][p]8. New Arrivals in Shops[/p][p]In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, and Rebate Shops, new items are added, including cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat bubble, cover chat background, furniture, and more.[/p][p]9. Set Information for Fashion Pieces[/p][p]After the update, you'll be able to see which set the fashion belongs to when viewing fashion details.[/p][p]Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.[/p][p]\[Optimizations and Bug Fixes][/p][p]1. Improved Wonder Connect matching mechanics to provide you with a smoother and more enjoyable challenging experience. Additionally, 15 new levels have been added for you to rise![/p][p]2. Optimized Hide UI function in dyeing modes. You can now tap the "Hide UI" button while in Dyeing, X Palette, and X Starlight modes to hide the interface and display only the character and outfit. Admire your dyeing creations without interface interruption![/p][p]3. Improved Home exchange settlement interface. You can now view the amount of Home Chestnuts consumed or refunded more clearly.[/p][p]4. Optimized background music save logic for the Panel interface. Your saved settings will now persist across different devices, ensuring you can always enjoy your favorite music.[/p][p]5. Fixed the display errors for certain dresses.[/p][p]6. Fixed the adaptation effects when pairing certain hairstyles with hair accessories.[/p][p]7. Optimized login popup logic. Popups will no longer appear in Home gameplay.[/p]

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content: [p]New events after the update on Jul. 16:[/p][p]1. New Cyber Community - Joint Wonderland[/p][p]Where raindrops can be heard among the tranquil bamboo forest,[/p][p]Where gentle breeze brings joy to the valleys and mountains,[/p][p]Where giant and glittering fish roam among buildings,[/p][p]Where mysterious dragon springs from under the water...[/p][p]It's the dreamy realm of artistry that blends with wild imaginations of the cyber era.[/p][p]The new community will open shortly after the version update with properties #1-4 available for purchase. Follow future notice for official open time.[/p][p]2. New Mind Travel Chapter: Memory Vine Opens on Jul. 30[/p][p]Ivy cascades down ancient courtyard walls, witness to countless encounters and partings through time.[/p][p]You've always kept in mind that reuniting with Ashley was a rehearsal for farewell.[/p][p]Withered vines will eventually return to the spring soil,[/p][p]While new sprouts forever reach toward the light.[/p][p]It's time to depart—join her on a journey of memory, loss, and rebirth.[/p][p]After the chapter opens, new 5-star set \[Vienna Dusk] will be available to craft.[/p][p]3. Wonder Connect Updates[/p][p]Cross-server matching is coming! After the function opens, you can match with more opponents from all servers and compete for honors whenever you want! [/p][p]Meanwhile, the much-anticipated \[Friends] mode will open too, where you can challenge your friends and see who's faster.  After the function opens, immerse yourself in the game on furniture \[Puzzle Machine] with an overlooking view! [/p][p]4. World Wonder Themed Furniture[/p][p]New and themed World Wonder furniture are available for purchase at Home. Mystic sculptures like \[Golden Dust Guide] and famed paintings like \[Snowhill Fox] will guide you through echos from thousands of years ago to decode secrets left by pharaoh. Pray to the non-speaking gods and appreciate sacred ruins from ancient nations, without leaving your home.[/p][p]5. Sign-in Collection - Vine Essence[/p][p]Vine Essence from previous sign-in rewards will be available to craft from Aug 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.[/p][p]6. New Arrivals in Shops[/p][p]In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are added, including avatar, chat background, chat bubble, photo frame, cute effect, furniture, and more.[/p][p]Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.[/p][p]\[Optimizations and Bug Fixes][/p][p]1. Optimized experience with login pop-up windows. [/p][p]2. Optimized the lens range effect at Wardrobe and Dye, now the lens can be adjusted to a higher position for previewing.[/p][p]3. Brand Effect level cap has been increased for Fashion Brands \[Amber Shimmer] \[Offshore Fireworks] \[Evening Star] \[Voice and Color]. Collecting the corresponding brand's fashion sets can increase the brand effect level.[/p][p]4. Fixed the clipping model issues on certain dresses. [/p][p]5. Fixed the position display errors for certain hair accessories during editing.[/p][p]6. Fixed the model display error that might happen when switching standing posture wearing certain back accessories.[/p][p]7. Fixed the issue that when switching idle poses wearing certain fashion pieces, the X Palette coloring display would play again from the start. [/p][p]8. Fixed the issue where mount \[Sacred Guardian] might wrongly appear in photo templates.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue that the interface is abnormally stuck after returning to the exchange shops after using photo templates.[/p][p]10. Fixed the problem that when switching accounts to invite pets for Pet Wefies, the invitation status is displayed incorrectly and the pet cannot be invited again.[/p][p]11. Fixed the issue that chat interface would wrongly appear in pet sharing interface.[/p][p]12. Fixed the issue that the character face might not be normally displayed for image slots for custom body types.[/p]

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content: [p]New content and optimizations after the update on Jun. 25:[/p][p]1. Duo-drive function for mount \[Abyss Companion][/p][p]After the encored Lightchase event \[Daybreak Abyss] is open, the duo-drive function will be supported for mount \[Abyss Companion]. You can exchange for the duo-drive license of the mount at \[Inspiration Center] and have the function unlocked automatically. Invite your friend for a ride at home and form your dragon paladin team. Embark a new journey of adventure witnessed by the dragon![/p][p]Dream Makers who have obtained the mount and unlocked its duo-drive function can tap and invite other players at Home for a ride together. Dream Makers who don't have the mount can send a duo-drive request to players riding the mount, and enjoy a ride with them after they accept the request.[/p][p]2. New Story Chapter 32: Liar's Game - Deconstruction Opens on Jul. 7[/p][p]The e-screen is ticking, the icy dome melts into rainfall, and the jade stone is crashed into pieces... How long indeed will it take to escape the old shackles?[/p][p]How will the puppets rid themselves of the strings that bind them, and how much can they trust the ones around?[/p][p]After the new chapter opens, new 4-star sets Coffee Islet/Dim Fluorescence/Fluffy Cake are available to craft.[/p][p]Meanwhile, Vvanna Challenge Chapter 32 will open too! Clear the stage for 5-star anklet - Frosty Specks, pose - Earnest Invite, photo frame - Plum in Snow, and more. 4-star dress - Flower Tease is added in Vvanna Shop.[/p][p]3. Ally Card Art Application[/p][p]After the upgrades, you can unlock and read Ally stories to set the card art as your profile cover or chat background. Allies without stories are available immediately when you unlock the card. Unleash the charm and dynamics in the cards and make them more immersive! [/p][p]Moreover, new and limited furniture \[Art Frame: Ally Window] will be available at Home. When interacting with the furniture, you can choose an Ally card to be displayed in the frame. Switch the cards as you want and appreciate the fascinating dynamic effects. The limited furniture \[Art Frame: Ally Window] will be sent to you via Email after you clear Story Quest 1-12. [/p][p]4. Ally Interface Upgrades[/p][p]Ally filter is added for Ally List and Ally Photo interfaces. Now you can filter the Allies by characters.[/p][p]No more limit on the number of Allies you can favor! Set any Ally you like as your favorite and find them more easily.[/p][p]Meanwhile, at Influence > Ally, you can switch the Favorite Ally display. Enjoy the evolved Ally cards too if you have evolved any![/p][p]5. Handheld Item Filter[/p][p]At Panel and Photo, you will be able to sort and search for the handheld items. Newly obtained handhelds will be tagged as new so that you can locate the handheld in mind faster![/p][p]6. New Arrivals in Shops[/p][p]In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, and Rebate Shops, new items are added, including cute effect, photo frame, avatar, cover chat background, chat bubble, furniture,  and more![/p][p]7. Sign-in Collection - Tender Companion[/p][p]Tender Companion from previous sign-in rewards will be available to make from Jul. 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.[/p][p]Note: The above events will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.[/p][p]\[Optimizations and Updates][/p][p]1. Fixed the clipping models for certain dresses.[/p][p]2. Fixed the distorted models for certain hairstyles when paired with hair accessories.[/p][p]3. Fixed the clipping models when pairing certain tops with certain bottoms.[/p][p]4. Fixed the exceptions in certain photo scenes.[/p][p]5. Fixed the persistent red dot display on Pet Hospital after fostering pets that can give birth.[/p][p]6. Fixed the issue where copied block furniture pieces have incorrect rotate parameters.[/p][p]7. Fixed the wrong prompt saying the special posture is still locked that might occur when setting a Fashion Diary cover.[/p][p]8. Fixed the possible issue where back accessories might be stuck under the foot when returning to Wardrobe from Exchange Shops.[/p][p]9. Fixed the issue where certain prompts block the progress bar in Wonder Connect.[/p][p]10. Optimized red dot logic for chat deco items.[/p]

notes.title: Event Notice
notes.content:
New events after the update on Jun. 4:

Event 1# New and Limited Lightchase - Chrono Sanctum
At 10:00 on May 28, 2025, limited Lightchase event - Chrono Sanctum will be live , featuring a new 6-star limited set and an SSR Ally! Within 25 performances, you are guaranteed to get a new limited 6-star fashion piece until you get the full limited 6-star fashion set! Collecting the full 6-star set can unlock exclusive entrance Pose (Dynamic Camera Pose) - Sanctum Verdict that can be used in Photo - Dynamic Pose. Moreover, Chrono Decom shop will be available. Decomposing fashions obtained from the limited-time event will allow you to redeem the limited 5-star Fashion piece - Foggy Veil, Pristine Jade, Cheese Burger, and Scene - Reverie Court, limited Furniture, Avatar Decoration, Chat Decoration, Photo item, Chrono Wind Vane, Yearning Wings, Ally EXP Key III, Gold, and more!
[Limited Sets]
6-Star Set - Divinity Domain
Battered and isolated, she remains the absolute authority nourished by the scarlet rose hues. 
[Special Notes]
The 6-Star Dress - Divinity Domain features 2 styles: elegant gown and bevelled skirt. The 6-Star Hat - Sacred Revelation features 3 styles: long veil, short veil, and back veil. The 6-Star Back Accessory - Verdict Time features 2 styles: Dissipate or Rewind, the latter creates a stunning "time-rewinding" effect where shards piece together rapidly like a rewound film until they recover to a complete form, while displaying accurate in-real-life time passage. The 6-Star Floating - Dome Ruins features 2 styles: sword matrix and broken walls, bringing you an epic-like beauty. Tap the Change Style button on fashion piece detail page or on the top-left corner of the fashion thumbnail to change its style. [Divinity Domain] features two exclusive postures: sword-wielding and war-battered. Tap Standing Posture at Wardrobe to switch, preview, and save. 
5-Star Set - Flute Melody
Wanna indulge in the flower ocean and flute sound, and have dreams both of us would laugh at.
4-Star - Newsclip Whisper
Cut off the time spent with you and make the prettiest letter and news clip.
[Limited Pieces]
6-Star Pieces: Mistveil Lure/Pool Pearl/Stone Curtain
5-Star Pieces: Rime Flow/Abyssal Gaze/Moon Humming/Vine Bloom/Jade Aroma/Heartbound Dream/Stellar Tarot
[Limited Makeup]
5-Star Makeup Sets: Starfall Grit/Frost Kiss/Dusk Sandwhirl/Soaked Rainbow/Ember Neon Sea/Scarlet Sandflow
[Limited Ally]
SSR Ally: Roy - Fallen Luminance
[Event Time]
Lightchase - Chrono Sanctum: Jun. 4, 09:00 - Jun. 24, 23:59 UTC
Decom Store - Chrono Decom: Jun. 4, 09:00 - Jun. 25, 23:59 UTC
[Event Details]
Sacred Chrono Invitation, value pack is coming!
During the event, a 49% discount is also available. Purchase [Authority Call Value Pack] and get [Authority Call] with only 60 Coupons. Perform to win your gorgeous fashion! 
You can also spend 118 Diamonds to purchase [Authority Call]. View more in Lightchase - Chrono Sanctum in the game.

Event 2# Login Bonus - Sanctum Oracle
[Event Time]
Jun. 4, 09:00 - Jun. 24, 23:59 UTC
[Event Details]
During the limited-time Lightchase event, you can log in to unlock exclusive stories in Sanctum Oracle. Read stories to get Authority Call x15, 5-Star Accessory - Golden Tangle, Cover Chat Background - Spring Sun, Photo Frame - Hazy Cage, and a total of 200 Diamonds!
Meanwhile, you can claim extra Diamond reward when you collect all the limited Sets in Chrono Sanctum: Divinity Domain, Flute Melody, and Newsclip Whisper.

Event 3# Divine Gifts Special Offer
During Limited Lightchase - Chrono Sanctum, [Divine Gifts] Diamond Packs are available!
[Event Time]
Jun. 4, 09:00 - Jun. 24, 23:59 UTC
[Event Details]
Players who have purchased the Elite Code can spend Diamonds on Authority Call I at a 22% discount. Each pack contains Authority Call x5, Energy x40, Gold x10000, and this pack can only be purchased twice.
You can also spend Diamonds on Authority Call II at a 22% discount. Each pack contains Authority Call x10, Energy x80, Gold x20000 and you can only purchase it once.

Event 4# Featured Gifts
[Event Time]
Jun. 4, 09:00 - Jun. 7, 23:59 UTC
[Event Details]
You can claim one gift every day during the event. Keep logging in to get Energy x100, Diamond x100, Authority Call x3, and Trend Color Chart x20. Don't miss out! 

Event 5# Father's Day Bonus
[Event Time]
Jun. 15, 00:00 - Jun. 18, 23:59 UTC
[Event Details]
Please accept the Father's Day gifts from us: [Diamond x200], [Energy x200], and [Gold x30000]. Wish all the fathers a joyous day!

Event 6# Relaxing Time
[Event Time]
Jun. 5, 09:00 - Jun. 12, 05:00 UTC
[Reward Claim]
Jun. 5, 09:00 - Jun. 13, 05:00 UTC
[Event Details]
During the event, complete daily Schedule tasks to gain Activity and win event attempts, up to 6 attempts per day. The attempts won't be cleared through out the event, so use them before they are gone! Every time you choose a pattern to open, the attempts are reduced by one, and you will get Relaxing Time rewards. If you open the complete pattern, you can get different Relaxing Time points, Trend Color Chart, Fancy Invitation, and many more! For more details, please refer to the in-game event page.
[Event Rewards]
Points obtained during the event can be exchanged for 4-Star Set [Lemon Ocean], Cute Effect [Bear Sweetie] and many other items.

Event 7# Detective's Eye
[Event Time]
Jun. 8, 09:00 - Jun. 12, 05:00 UTC
[Reward Claim]
Jun. 8, 09:00 - Jun. 12, 05:00 UTC
[Event Details]
Complete daily events to earn Activity and Investigation Chances, up to 3 chances per day. The Investigation Chances won't be cleared during the whole event. When the investigation starts, you need to mark all differences between the two scenes within 3 minutes to complete the investigation. Also, you'll get different Ratings based on the time used. A limited Title will be granted if you collect 9 Perfect Ratings. For more event details, please refer to the in-game event rules.
[Event Rewards]
Earn Detective Points to obtain the 5-star accessory - Lit Intoxication, cute effect - Kitten Disco, Diamond x30, Trend Color Chart x9, and more!

Event 8# Litchi Tour
[Event Time]
Jun. 9, 09:00 - Jun. 23, 05:00 UTC
[Reward Claim]
Jun. 9, 09:00 - Jun. 24, 05:00 UTC
[Event Details]
During the event, complete daily Schedule tasks to gain Activity and win event attempts, up to 2 attempts per day. The attempts won't be cleared through out the event, so use them before they are gone! The tour features 3 distances and 8 directional areas to choose from. Before departing, purchase food and supplies for your pack. Litchi Kitten will select destinations based on your travel supplies. The farther Litchi Kitten travels, the more time required, but also more Litchi Coins and Travel Funds earned. Each directional area contains 3 special landmarks. notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New content and optimizations after the update on Jun. 4:
1. New Mind Travel Chapter: Nostalgic Rain Open on Jun. 4
As the storm washes away aged dust, sealed memories resurface slowly.
Awkward moments and secret thoughts ring a bell over the boiling soup, as you watch the unspoken love eventually turn into a belated rain.
Listen carefully, for Larry is going to share the heartbeats of the raindrops with you.
After the chapter is open, new set [Twilight Shore] will be ready in Fashion Studio. 

2. Camera Motion Effects for Dynamic Poses
After the function opens, camera effects for all Dynamic Camera Poses will be available as exclusive camera motions, usable freely with other poses or scenes in Photo Mode.

Owned Dynamic Poses will automatically unlock corresponding camera motions, viewable at [Photo - Motion - Camera Motion]. The function will open shortly after the version update. Follow future notice for official open time.

3. New Arrivals at Exchange
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are available, including furniture, cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat background, chat bubble, etc.

Note: The above events will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed an issue where adjusting the panel camera distance occasionally failed after using templates.
2. Fixed an issue where the panel camera couldn't rotate after switching panel templates.
3. Fixed an issue where photo templates weren't correctly saving sharpening data.
4. Fixed an abnormal mount display when copying appearances in Reshape Look interface with a mount item.
5. Fixed an issue where fostered pets would still appear when sharing Fashion Diaries.
6. Fixed the clipping issues in certain dresses' models.
7. Fixed the incorrect display when styling with certain shoes.
8. Fixed the clipping issues in certain accessories.
9. Fixed the display error for certain makeup items.
10. Optimized the display effects for certain scenes.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New content and optimizations after the update on May 14:

1. Story Quest Chapter 31: Liar's Game - Dismantled will open on May 26
A desolated lab, an unknown eerie space, something dangerous is closing in, along with the beating of the heart.
Thump, thump—
However, as long as I can untangle the lies and grip the truth - no matter how untouchable it might be - I will still be able to hold that warm hand again, right?

After the new chapter is open, new 5-star set - Violet Stream, 4-star sets - Chambered Rose/Hazy Ocean will be ready to craft.

Vvanna Challenge Chapter 31 will open too!
Clear the stage to obtain 5-star necklace - Lock and Key, pose - Queen's Command, photo frame - Golden Glamour, and more. 4-star new dress - Colorful Crystal is added in Vvanna Shop.

2. New and limited Dragon Boat Festival Recipe
From May 31, 05:00 to Jun. 7, 05:00 UTC, limited NPC - Happy Summer will show up at your Homes with purchasable recipe [Kite Race]. Don't miss out!

3. Themed Furniture - Life Playground
New Furniture - Life Playground is now available in your Home! Purchase it through Build. You can also get charming furniture like Machine Tweak and Calorie Burner. No matter what personality type you are, Life Playground helps you create a distinctive home that showcases your unique character, making your home stand out!

4. Optimization for Headwear - Scarlet Feather from Snow Ruins
Fashion Set - Snow Ruins upgraded! Headwear - Scarlet Feather now features Style 2 - Phoenix Plume. You can now switch between elegance and majesty! Tap the Change Style button on fashion piece detail page or on the top-left corner of the fashion thumbnail to change its style.

5. New Arrivals at Shops
In Convenience Shop, Ally Shop, and Rebate Shop, new items are added, including Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Avatar, Cover Chat Background, Chat Bubble, Furniture, and more. 

6. Sign-in Collection - Bunny Dynamite
Bunny Dynamite from previous sign-in rewards will be available to craft from Jun 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.

Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Combined wardrobe pet switching and positioning features. Now select pets and adjust their position in one place for easier management.
2. Fixed layer display errors for certain hairstyles.
3. Fixed clipping issues when styling with certain dresses.
4. Fixed the issue that prevented certain lipsticks from being dyed. 
5. Fixed performance errors for certain photo scenes.
6. Optimized the camera angle display when interacting with furniture at Home with the first-person perspective.
7. Fixed the issue where character might fall onto the lower ground after using Studio Mode at Home.
8. Fixed the red dot display error for switched accounts in Guild Notice page.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Apr. 23:

1. Accessory Customization
Not entirely satisfied with how you can wear the hair accessories, face accessories, or hats? The new Accessory Customization function is available to level up your styling experience! With the new function, you can customize the position/size/rotation of hair accessories, hats, and face accessories. Time to make your wardrobe accessory staples shine once again!

2. Sign-in Collection - Early Starlight
Early Starlight from previous sign-in rewards will be available to craft from May 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.

3. New Arrivals in Shops
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are added, including avatar, chat background, chat bubble, photo frame, cute effect, furniture, and more.

4. Updated Login Page Video
Videos on login page are updated with fashions debuting during the past year!

5. Part of the loading images are updated on mobile version and PC version's horizontal mode.

Note: The above event contents will be initially released on select servers for testing.




[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. An overwatching form is added for the 6-star back accessory [Fairy Music]. A burning wheel for is added for [Eclipsing Ring]. A moonlit ripple form is added for [Time Moon Wheel]. Enjoy the infinite styling possibility! Tap [Change Style] button on fashion detail page or on top-left corner of the fashion thumbnail to switch fashion styles.
2. Optimized status filtering rule for caring all pet function, including pets in red status when selecting yellow status.
3. Optimized your experience while in water, so that you can jump or leave the water by driving a mount.
4. Level rewards for Brand Gallery have been increased to Lv. 41. Collect fashions for more rewards!
5. Improved display of the Ally interface when in horizontal mode on the PC client.
6. Enhanced the dye areas for the dress [Secret Garden], adding dye area #13 for customizing the lower hem.
7. Fixed the clipping issue for certain hair styles.
8. Fixed the clipping issue for certain dresses.
9. Optimized display effects for certain coats.
10. Fixed abnormal display of certain eyeliners in specific scenes.
11. Fixed an issue where Customize Accessory and Posture buttons sometimes failed to appear at Wardrobe.
12. Fixed an issue where dual photo templates occasionally failed to save camera positions correctly.
13. Fixed an issue where Panel templates were sometimes unusable.
14. Fixed incorrect collision detection for certain building blocks in Home.
15. Fixed the display errors in certain circumstances when in first-person perspective at Home.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Apr. 2:

1. Story Chapter 30: Cave Marriage - Sacrifice opens on Apr. 14
Desolated village, abandoned girl, rampant disease, blatant crimes.
When the box of desire is opened, who is able to maintain their dignity?

After the chapter is open, new 4-star sets [Tangerine Heart], [Void Fantasy], and [Modern Slay] will be available to craft.

Vvanna Challenge of Chapter 30 will be open too!
Clear the stage for 5-star earrings [Fairy Shimmer], pose [Sunrise Beat], photo frame [Speed Train], etc. New 4-star dress [Hymning Ripple] will be exchangeable in Vvanna Shop.

2. Camera Motion
Find the new function at Photo > Camera Motion or Home > Photo > Camera Motion. Various camera motion effects offer unique camera transitions that help you capture every shiny moments in game. Showcase your unique beauty and stun everyone with enhanced photo composition.

3. New Postures for Handheld Handbags
New hand postures are added for all handheld handbags, and you can choose how you want to pose with the bag, from single-hand posture, to two-hand posture. With the 30+ handbag postures at your choice, you can be elegant, smart, feisty, or whatever you feel like!

4. Standing Posture for Image Slot
Save current standing postures in your Image Slots by selecting [Image Slot preview posture] when uploading the images. Better coordinate your image slot style with the postures.

5. First-person Perspective at Home
Explore and enjoy the view at your home with an immersive first-person perspective! Find the function at Home > Camera and see the shining world and its every detail!

6. Panel Template
Too many painstakingly made panel views but too few saving slots? The new panel template function will wipe out the pain! Save your panel parameters as templates and tap to apply any time you want to use them again!

7. Searching and Sorting at Panel
Spending way too much time finding the pose in your mind for your panel? The searching and sorting functions have come to your aid. New poses will be tagged as New in the list too!

8. Duo Photo Template
You can soon use a photo template for two when taking photos! Save your fine-tuned photo parameters as templates and reuse them later for Wefies. Follow future notice for official open time.

9. Matching Puzzle Gameplay
It's going to be a challenge of both speed and strategy!
The new gameplay is coming soon, where you will be able to choose between [Matching Mode] and [Solo Mode]. In [Matching Mode], a game for two, you can join during the open hours and obtain [Joy Heart], which can be used to exchange for Home furniture, Home water body, exquisite avatar, Chestnuts, and more! Interesting titles await when you make certain achievements! In [Solo Mode] where there is no closed time, you can enjoy the game free of pressure from a rival.

You can also enjoy the game on the new furniture [Puzzle Machine] with exclusive character animation! Invite your besties for a contest of speed and reap both the rewards and the fame! Follow future notice for official open time.

10. Membership Perk: Care All Pets
New and updated perk for Exclusive Membership or Privilege Membership owners! Say goodbye to the burdensome caring procedures and care all the pets with one click! The function is available at both the main page and home.

11. Raised Pet Family/Foster Care Slots
You can unlock up to 18 family member slots for pets and up to 28 Foster Care slots. Say hi to more pet friends!

12. New Mount and Fashion Rewards in Rebate Shops
New 5-star mount fashion [Sprite Hunter] is added in Value Rebates. Obtaining the mount [Sprite Hunter] will unlock its flying function automatically. Ride the light and swift paraglider in the air and enjoy every detail at home!

New 5-star face accessory [Siren's Whispers] is added in Special Rebates, 5-star hairstyle [Twilight Neon] in Super Rebates, and 5-star set [Honor and Zeal] in Deluxe Rebates.

More items are added in Rebate Shops, including home water bodies, home land surfaces, camera motion, cute effect, chat bubble, title, etc. 

13. Extended VIP Rebates
Starting from VIP Lv. 39 [Nebula Ode], unlock and claim newly added rebate fashions by order: 6-star set [Snow Ruins] and 5-star set [Faithful Rose]. Moreover, exquisite rewards are claimable along the way, including kitten fashion [Peachy Meow], puppy fashion [Tulip Thoughts], bunny fashion [Rabbit Escape], scene [Dreamy Island], dynamic pose, dynamic chat bubble, dynamic chat background, dynamic avatar frame, advanced effect title, etc.

14. New Arrivals in Shops
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are added, including avatar, chat background, chat bubble, photo frame, cute effect, furniture, and more.

Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized the clipping issue when pairing certain hairstyles with fashions.
2. Fixed the display errors when styling with certain dresses.
3. Fixed the layer display errors when styling with certain coats.
4. Fixed the display errors when styling with certain shoes.
5. Fixed the layer display errors when styling with certain handheld items.
6. Fixed mouth distortion issues with the pet rabbit under certain customization settings.
7. Fixed a bug causing the game to incorrectly display in horizontal mode when using photo templates
8. Corrected abnormal ground shadow rendering in the photo scenes [Promise of Sea] and [Stellar Wanderer].
9. Fixed an issue where the Guild red dot notification was not displaying properly.
46. Resolved facial detail errors in Larry's SR Ally [Siege Night].

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Mar. 12:

1. New Mind Travel Chapter - Heart Blossom opens on Mar. 12
Fireworks bloom brilliantly, as if starlight flows between heaven and earth.
You linger in the night, while the night dwells in his eyes.
Opening that door, sealed for two decades,
Gerald wishes to introduce you to the echoes of his past...

After the chapter is open, new set [Star Riddle] is ready to craft at Fashion Studio.

2. [Meow Exclusive] Duo-drive Function
Dream Makers who've unlocked [Meow Exclusive] will receive an Email after they clear Story Quest stage 1-11. The email contains [Meow Exclusive] Duo-drive License that can unlock the Duo-drive function for [Meow Exclusive] mount. Tap another player at Home and you can invite them for a ride together.

Dream Makers who haven't got [Meow Exclusive] will also receive an Email once they clear Story Quest stage 1-11. The email contains a [Meow Exclusive] Mount Pack that includes 5-Star Fashion [Meow Exclusive], its Driving License, Flying License, and Duo-drive License.

3. New Street Trend Theme Furniture
New and themed furniture are available at Home > Build, including [Journey Tracks], [Emergency Exit], and [With Gratitude]. Authentic street style furniture will bring the urban fashion and dynamics to your home!

4. Sign-in Collection - Island Wandering
Island Wandering from previous sign-in rewards will be available to make from Apr. 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.

5. New Arrivals at Shops
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Rebate Shops, new items are added, including avatar, chat background, chat bubble, photo frame, cute effect, furniture, and more.

Note: Certain functions will be available in part of the servers first and then for all.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Decom Bench redirect is added on [Glittering Decom], [Glorious Decom], and [Fancy Decom] interfaces.
2. Fixed the incorrect order display when pairing certain hairs with fashions.
3. Fixed the display error when wearing certain dress on girl's body type.
4. Fixed the wrong display position of certain tops when paired with certain necklace on girl's body type.
5. Fixed the clipping model issue when wearing certain shoes on custom body types.
6. Fixed the issue when certain pets enter their senior stage, "Recovering from breeding" is still wrongly shown on Foster Care interface.
7. Fixed the issue where other players' models might not be displayed at Home on certain devices.
8. Fixed the issue that after entering Home, when returning to the main page from other interfaces, the Panel dynamic camera is wrongly played.
9. Fixed the issue where palette page cannot slide when dyeing eye shadows, causing the incomplete display for certain eye shadow palettes.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Feb. 19:
1. Story Quest Chapter 29: Cave Marriage - Standby Opens on Mar. 3
A strange game of death in a silent, desolate village.
Familiar faces show up one after another - what's their secrets?
Gongs and drums, flickering candlelight. Welcome to the side quest of the game - Cave Marriage.
Make sure you are prepared.

After the chapter opens, new 5-star Fashion - Sprite's Kiss, 4-Star Fashion - Early Mist, 4-Star Fashion - Dusk Reed are available to craft at Fashion Studio.

2. Apply Dynamic Pose Camera at Panel
After the function is open, you will be able to use corresponding camera of selected Dynamic Pose at Panel, adding a personal, immersive touch to your main page while enjoying your character in a dynamic way.

Reminder: Poses with dynamic camera have a special mark on the bottom right corner.

3. New Stunning Image Templates
Multiple Face IDs of the game's fashion sets without makeup have been added in Image Template for you to use! Check them out at Character Creation or Reshape Look and find the perfect image for your fabulous cosmetics!

4. Main Page Music Optimizations
Search and sort your playlist at Panel with our new and optimized user interface. You can now select your favored background music and enjoy the personalized acoustic experience.

5. Jump & Sprint
Tap Jump button at Home to jump. Tapping Sprint button while jumping will trigger a sprint effect.

6. Sign-in Collection - Coconut Litchi
Previous sign-in reward - Coconut Litchi will be available to craft on Mar. 1 at Design Room > Fashion Studio > Sign-in Collection.

7. In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are added, including Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Avatar, Chat Background, Chat Bubble, Furniture, and more.

Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized display issue for certain hairstyles when styling with them.
2. Fixed clipping issue for certain fashions.
3. Optimized exceptions with certain poses' performance. 
4. Fixed the issue where pets might clip through the walls on Build mode at Home.
5. Fixed the Image Slot upload failure that might occur on a weak network connection.
6. Fixed the issue where Energy gifted from friends might not show up.
7. Corrected the wardrobe camera tilt issue after resetting a tilted camera in the Panel interface.
8. Resolved shadow flickering when characters and pets are on-screen simultaneously.
9. Fixed the overly stretched photo effect [] when used on PC horizontal mode.
10. Optimized the display position for tool's instruction tips on PC Home Build mode.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Jan. 29:

1. New and Limited Spring Festival Recipe
From Jan. 29, 05:00 to Feb. 6, 05:00 UTC, limited-time NPC - New Year Jiaozi will show up at Home. Prepare and taste New Year dinner to complete the requirements: [New Year Chef] and [Bountiful Dinner] and claim from the NPC limited recipe - Festive Snake. Don't miss out!

2. New and Limited Lantern Festival Recipe
From Feb. 12, 05:00 to Feb. 19, 05:00 UTC, limited-time NPC - Big Ear Bunny will show up at Home with purchasable recipe - Snake Lantern. Don't miss out!

3. New and Limited Valentine's Day Recipe
From Feb. 14, 05:00 to Feb. 21, 05:00 UTC, limited-time NPC - Heartful Bear will show up at Home with purchasable recipe - Earnest Promise. Don't miss out!

4. Sign-in Collection - Chestnut Core
Previous sign-in reward - Chestnut Core will be available to craft on Feb. 1 at Design Room > Fashion Studio > Sign-in Collection.

5. New Arrivals in Shops
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Value Rebates, new items are added, including Avatar, Chat Background, Chat Bubble, Photo Frame, Cute Effect, Furniture, and more.

Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized the stopping performance when using joy stick to walk around home.
2. Fixed the issue that prevented you from choosing pets in Angel Funfair for photo when there is no pet in Pet Family.
3. Fixed the issue that prevented you from dyeing certain areas on mount [Sacred Guardian].
4. Fixed the clipping issue between mount [Meow Exclusive] and certain fashions.
5. Fixed the clipping issue on certain hairstyles.
6. Fixed the clipping issue on certain dresses.
7. Fixed the issue where image slot makeup dye changes will be reverted to default after switching tabs when taking photos with your image slot.
8. Fixed the possible issue where the stool would not appear when cooking at home in a girl's body type.
9. Fixed the issue that you can still pick up dishes at home while riding a mount.
10. Optimized camera operation on Mount interface, so that you can now zoom in and move the camera up or down to view the mount.
11. Fixed the issue where mounts would be wrongly displayed when entering story investigation or mind simulation after putting a mount on the main page.
12. Fixed the issue where mounts would be wrongly displayed on pet sharing interface.
13. Fixed the issue where mounts would be wrongly displayed when previewing scenes or poses in Decom Shop.
14. Fixed the clippings on the thigh when riding mounts in certain fashions.
15. Fixed the camera display error what would occur on PC client when tapping certain buttons on pet touching interface.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Jan. 8:

1. Drive and Fly Mount [Sacred Guardian]
After the update, 6-star Mount - Sacred Guardian's driving and flying function will be unlocked automatically. Drive the mysterious and dignified unicorn freely on the driveway or fly in the air as you explore every nook and cranny in your home!

2. Duo-Driving Open for Mount [Sacred Guardian]
You can ride the Mount [Sacred Guardian] with others and enjoy the freedom with a companion!

After the function is unlocked, Dream Makers who own the mount can tap and select another player at Home to invite them for a free ride! Dream Makers who don't have the mount can send requests to players riding mount Sacred Guardian, and join them in the ride after they accept the request!

3. Mount Switch
Select a mount from your inventory and explore your home in your best look! Whether it's the cyber motor [Meow Exclusive], or the mysterious [Sacred Guardian], you can switch among the mounts as you prefer at Home > Mount to enjoy the diversified fun of driving!

Moreover, movement range in every property has been expanded for a freer exploration. Observe from the new perspective in the air, and you might discover stunning views you never expect. Come on and drive your way through every corner!

4. Pet Fashion X Palette
Once you unlock all the palettes for a pet fashion, you'll be able to open the X Palette with Home Chestnuts! Customize the hue/saturation/lightness on different dye areas or just enter the 6-digit RGB color value directly to create color combos as you prefer. It's time to level up the wardrobe of your fluffy friends!

Meanwhile, opening pet fashion X Palette will also bring you the [X Starlight] dynamic dye plan automatically. Prepare yourself for the fabulous color manifestation!

The X Palette function is applicable on all pet fashion pieces. The world of Life Makeover, a place where you dazzle with your pets!

5. Story Quest Chapter 28: Lost Sky - Snap opens on Jan. 20
When trapped in an endless swirl of reincarnation, finding the truth is the only key to escape. 
As death looms, the familiar whispers will guide the way.
If the cycle ends right now, will you make the same choice?

After the chapter opens, 4-Star Sets - Flaming Bow/Crimson Tribute/Wilderness Rose will be available to craft at Fashion Studio.

6. Dreamy Constellation Themed Furniture
New dreamy constellation themed furniture is available at Home > Build, including mysterious pieces such as [Night Essence] and [Dance of Balance]. The themed furniture takes inspiration from the mysterious cosmos and radiant stars, incorporating unique elements of the twelve signs into the furniture design. Each piece carries a story of the universe, adding a touch of cosmos mystery and romance to your living space.



[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed the clipping issues in certain fashions.
2. Fixed the possible wrong names recorded in Pet Diary when you play with the pets.
3. Fixed the issue where pet rabbits would float in the air when sleeping on certain bed furniture.
4. Fixed certain errors in Vvanna Quiz answer descriptions.
5. Fixed the possible shadow display error when using photo templates.

Notes: All above content will be available for a limited number of servers first and then for all.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Dec. 18:

[New Features]
1. New Pet Species - Rabbits
Super adorable bunnies are coming! Prepare for their long, wiggly fluffy ears and so much fun! Adopt the newly available White Lops at Pet > Adoption Center, and meet more cutie bunny species at Pet Store—Hare Lop, Pointed Lop, Tortoise Lop, Dutch Lop, and Dotted Lop!

With the uniquely equipped pet customization system, you can fine tune dozens of details for the pet bunnies, including their ears, eyes, nose, etc. 

Bunnies of different species can breed with each other and bring out wonderful surprises of new life. The exclusive AI algorithm in inheritance and mutation makes each bunny different, from looks to body types, and from furs to coats! Breeding lop-eared with big-ear can also bring you the special big-lop bunny babies that inherit traits of both breeds. Moreover, certain breeding conditions may bring big-lops traits of their predecessors, making them lop-eared or big-ear babies.

For bunny stylists, bunny outfits that are super adorable will be available in shops too! Exchange outfits with Home Chestnuts and style the furry cuties with outfit [Greedy Bunny], headwear [Fidgeting Bunny], and face accessory [Adorable Gaze]! 

Bouncing, playing, winning your attention, the bunnies will surely freshen your eyes with their own variety of interactions. With the specially designed photo poses and unique bunny forms different from that of kittens and pups, the pet rabbits have so much fun stored for you! 

2. New Mind Travel: Nightlong Snow Opens on Jan. 1, 2025
Snow covers the long street, streetlight kindles at night.
The connection between lives is a result of both care and a doctor's kindness.
When the link breaks off, however, how will Roy let go?

After the chapter is open, new 5-Star Set - Light Radiator will be available to make at Fashion Studio.

3. New and Limited Christmas Recipe
From Dec. 22, 5:00 to Dec. 29, 5:00 UTC, timed NPC - Tame Reindeer will appear at you Home with purchasable recipe - Gingerbread Funfair. Don't miss out!

4. New Arrivals in Shops
In Convenience Store, Ally Shop, and Rebate Shops, new items are added, including pose, cute effect, photo frame, avatar, chat background, furniture, etc. 




[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed display exceptions in certain hairstyles.
2. Fixed the wrong display position of hats when they are paired with certain fashions on girl's body types.
3. Fixed the clipping issue that would occur on certain dresses.
4. Fixed the missing models of certain fashions on certain device models.
5. Fixed the missing handheld item when previewing interactive poses with pets at Panel while wearing a handheld.
6. Fixed the ineffective Speed changes at Panel when exiting the gameplay by tapping Back button.
7. Fixed the issue with saving Panel changes when pets are outside the Scene's movement range on Studio Mode when switching different Scenes.
8. Fixed the errors in displaying others' system avatars and default avatars on Hospital > Obstetrics when breeding pets with others.
9. Fixed the issue that characters in certain girl's body types could not use the furniture [Patched Color Stand].
10. Fixed the time display errors when using video recording function on certain devices.





New Mount System Coming Soon!

Dear Dream Maker,

The new Mount System will be available after the update on Jan. 8, where you can drive the mount and explore a greater world!

If you obtain the 6-star Mount - Sacred Guardian from Lightchase event - Everlasting Glory, the mount's driving and flying function will be automatically unlocked after the update on Jan. 8. Ride the mysterious and noble unicorn on the driveway or fly freely in the air to explore every nook and cranny in your home!

Additionally, duo-driving function will also be available for Mount - Sacred Guardian. Dream Makers who own the mount can tap and select another player at Home to invite them for a free ride! Dream Makers who don't have the mount can send requests to players riding mount Sacred Guardian, and join them in the ride after they accept the request!

More mount varieties are on the way. Stay tuned to the diversified fun of driving and mix-and-matching!

Life Makeover Team





Notes: All above is only a preview of the coming update. Actual content may vary.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Nov. 27:

[New Features]
1. Pet Family/Foster Care Slot Extended
You can now unlock up to 15 Family Member Slots and 24 Foster Care Slots, say hi to more fur friends!

2. New Story Quest Chapter 27: Lost Sky - Riddle will open on Dec. 9

Journey through time, and listen to the meshing of gears in the age of steam.
Outsiders lurk among the crowd, concealing secrets beneath their false facades.
Will the solitary vessel soaring through distant skies guide you to the cruel finale foretold in prophecy?

After the chapter opens, new 5-star set - Wavy Glamour, 4-star sets - Memory Album/Lofty Beauty will be ready to make at Fashion Studio.

Story Quest Chapter 27 Vvanna Challege will open too!

Clear the stage to obtain 5-star Anklet - Golden Orchid, Pose - Future Embrace, Photo Frame - Spring Flowers Reborn, and more. New 4-star Dress - Darkening Cherry will be available at Vvanna Shop.

3. New Items in Shops
New arrivals in Glimmer Shop and Inspiration Center, including Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Chat Background, Furniture, and more.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]

1. Optimized the camera movement range in certain scenes on Studio Mode.
2. Fixed the performance exceptions in certain hairstyles.
3. Fixed the performance errors in certain dresses.
4. Fixed the performance issues with the character body and limbs during certain poses.
5. Fixed the issue where the handheld item was not correctly removed when changing the pet to be held at Panel.
6. Optimized the algorithm in pet breeding that affects the occurrence and inheritance of facial patterns, including eye masks and whiskers.
7. Fixed the red dot display on Hospital when pets eligible to deliver are put in Angel Funfair. Now such pets will have a pregnant label on them, but they can only deliver after being taken back to Family.
8. Fixed the issue where friend chat messages might appear repetitively.

Note: All above is only a preview of the coming update. Actual content may vary.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Nov. 6:

[New Features]
1. Advanced Reshape 2.0
The Advanced Reshape Mode levels up to bring you more body type and appearance diversity! We'll make it truly possible for you to recreate your real-life image and find every-day outfit inspiration from the in-game wardrobe!

In the upgraded Advanced Reshape, you will have more freedom to custom the height, weight, and even head-body ratio: We've expanded the range for neck and shoulder adjustment, allowing you to fine-tune neck length and thickness, as well as shoulder height, width, and thickness from multiple dimensions. We've also added more adjustment details on arms, hands, chest, waist, legs, and feet. Every detail aims to serve your pursuit of perfection. Come and embrace a brand new self! 

2. Mind Travel Chapter: Grand Names opens on Nov. 6
A long-buried video tape plunges a renowned director into controversy. Is it the work of malicious rumors, or is there more lurking beneath the surface?
The old instructions still echo in Shawn's mind, urging him to bring the slanders into justice.
Yet the closer he is to the truth, he feels as if falling into an absurd script...

After the chapter is open, new 5-star Set [Epiphyllum Dream] will be ready to craft at Fashion Studio!

3. Studio Mode Optimizations
When switching different half-length and whole-body static poses in Photo - Character Photo - Studio Mode, the camera parameters will not change to the pose-default ones, but keep the current ones. You can use the default parameters by tapping on the Whole-body/Selfie/Face buttons on the bottom right corner.

4. Photo Template
No need to recite the complicated camera parameters every time you take a photo when the Photo Template function is available! You will be able to save your painstakingly arranged photo parameters, such as pose, scene, retouch, etc,  as your personalized templates, so that next time you need, you only need to tap on the templates and apply all the settings with one click. Try out the new function for a more enjoyable and efficient photo experience!

5. Panel Studio Mode & Height Adjustment
Been thinking of a freer Panel Camera? Here comes the ultra camera scale for Panel in Studio Mode! Change the angle as you wish and showcase your beauty with no reservation. Save the perfect image composition and customize your very own Panel layout!

Moreover, height adjusting is supported in Studio Mode too. Escape the control of gravity and embrace the free space of creation in various landscapes. With the new function, you can decide if you want to dive deep into the ocean or to feel the weightless floating magic. You can adjust heights for each individual and pet in Wefie, With Pet, and Pet Photo modes. Explore the possibilities and have fun!

6. Optimized Character Movement in Studio Mode
We've made more space for your characters to move during Studio Mode photo-shooting! Now you can move your character to below the horizon in all the Scenes, no matter it's the ground, the ice surface, or the water surface!

Moreover, we've extended the range for character movement in all directions in 27 Scenes in the Studio Mode, including [Brand New Start], [Bamboo Waterfall], [Boating Rain], [Caged Galaxy], [Exotic City], [Glowing Arcade], [Haunted Box], [Falling Cherry Date: Clear], [Falling Cherry Date: Melt], [Crescent Ambassador], [Yard of Vow], [Clear Sea Summer], [Lit Night: Luminous], [Lit Night: Mystery], and more. Unlock more hidden surprises by changing the place you are at - whether it's to stand high up on the building top in the cherry season, or to play around the coach - explore the upgraded fun of photo-shooting after this version update!

7. Home Gameplay Update
When in extreme states, i.e. Ravenous and Replete, you can still switch between Walking and Running modes. Nonetheless, we hope you won't get starved too often.

8. New Themed Furniture - Old Charm
New furniture arrivals ready to bring you back to the old time and relive a romantic dream. Purchase at Home > Build new pieces including [Wired Memory], [Past Telecom],  [Blurry Dream], and more.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Fixed the style display error that might occur during Wefie shooting when you take photos with your Image Slot character, each of the character dressed in different styles of the same piece.
2. In certain properties in [Forest Castle] and [Utopian Paradise], the issue of wrong camera height that would occur when using Panorama Mode and Studio Mode in basements has been fixed.
3. Fixed the issue that raindrop effect would appear on interior decorative windows.
4. Fixed the issue where gray lines might appear when previewing Vvanna Community images uploaded from mobile device albums.
5. Fixed the reappearing friend chats even after they are deleted.
6. Fixed the display error in certain hairstyles.
7. Fixed the clipping models of certain fashions on custom body type.
8. Fixed performance errors during certain poses.

Notes: All above is only a preview of the coming update. Actual content may vary.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Oct. 16:

[New Features]
1. More Home Gameplay Optimizations
(1) Freer Door&Window Placement: New Doors and Windows that can be placed freely are available, now you don't need a wall to place them! Additionally, we've also added Sliding Doors and Folding Doors for you to choose for your personalized decor design. 
(2) Show/Hide Grids: In Advanced Building Mode, you can choose to hide or display the grids whenever you want. Hide the grids and lines when you need a clearer view to get a whole picture of the layout, and show them when you need to position and calibrate the pieces accurately. 
(3) Updated Block Mode: New block shapes arrived - Round Slice and Arch. While Round Slice Blocks smooth the visual presentation, the Arch Blocks add the artistic curve to the space. 

2. New Story Chapter 26: Deep Dive - Abyss opens on Oct. 28.
The deep sea might not be a perfect place for secrets, but one can totally bury their sorrows in it.
The sleeping doll in the memories will no longer be able to open her eyes again.
It's time for this farewell magic show to end, as the seabed train approaches its destination...

After the chapter is open, new 4-star sets - Wilderness Song/Baa Discovery/Secluded Lotus are available to make at Fashion Studio.

Story Quest Chapter 26 Vvanna Challenge will open too!
Clear the stage to obtain 5-star Earrings - Moon Glory, Pose - Honey Date, Cute Effect - Yes, My Queen, etc. New 4-star Dress - Franken's Trial will be available in Vvanna Shop.

3. Fashion Code Set
Starting from this Fashion Code, collecting all the fashion pieces in Fashion Code will unlock the corresponding Set and Brand Gallery set collection rewards. Unlocking all Palettes and X Palettes for the Fashion Code Set will also bring you the dye collection rewards and X Starlight collection rewards, as well as the Set's Branding Bonus. Previous Fashion Code pieces can also be found as Sets if you've collected all of them.

4. Halloween-Limited Recipe
From Oct. 31 to Nov. 6, when the world of Life Makeover enters nighttime, which is real life time 00:30-3:30 UTC, 6:30-9:30 UTC, 12:30-15:30 UTC, and 18:30-21:30 UTC, limited NPC [Pumpkin Summer] will show up in your homes with purchasable recipe [Grand Stele Night]. Don't miss out!

5. New Arrivals at Shops
In Glimmer Shop and Inspiration Center, new items are added, including Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Chat Background, Furniture, and more.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized color inheritance algorithm for pet breeding, so that pet babies now have a chance to inherit colors from any color area on their parents, on every color area of theirs.
2. Fixed the issue that when naming infant pets obtained from breeding under certain circumstances, their models would keep changing.
3. Fixed the wrong position of pets that are held in hand on PC client when switching between vertical and horizontal mode.
4. Fixed performance errors in certain hairstyles.
5. Fixed the clipping issue and adaptation issue in certain fashions.
6. Fixed the incorrect performance in certain poses.
7. Fixed the issue that when using two-person poses for a Wefie and tapping to jump to another interface, the Wefie interface and pose might be wrong after returning back. 
8. Fixed the issue that the number of Vvanna Community post comments might be wrong.

Notes: All above is only a preview of the coming update. Actual content may vary.

In the upgraded Advanced Reshape, you will have more freedom to custom the height, weight, and even head-body ratio: We've expanded the range for neck and shoulder adjustment, allowing you to fine-tune neck length and thickness, as well as shoulder height, width, and thickness from multiple dimensions. We've also added more adjustment details on arms, hands, chest, waist, legs, and feet. Every detail aims to serve your pursuit of perfection. Come and embrace a brand new self!

2. More Home Gameplay Optimizations
(1) Freer Door&Window Placement: New Doors and Windows that can be placed freely are available, now you don't need a wall to place them! Additionally, we've also added Sliding Doors and Folding Doors for you to choose for your personalized decor design. 
(2) Show/Hide Grids: In Advanced Building Mode, you can choose to hide or display the grids whenever you want. Hide the grids and lines when you need a clearer view to get a whole picture of the layout, and show them when you need to position and calibrate the pieces accurately. 
(3) Updated Block Mode: New block shapes arrived - Round Slice and Arch. While Round Slice Blocks smooth the visual presentation, the Arch Blocks add the artistic curve to the space.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Sep. 4:

[New Features]
1. New Story Quest Chapter 25: Deep Dive - Ocean will open on Sep. 23

A report letter drags the biomedical research institution "Blue Ark" into storms.
Turbulence of conflicts keeps raging, and the victim turns out to be... Jolie?!
The imprint of tarot shows up again. Truth pursuers, get on this "Undersea Express".
After all, the depth in the sea is a perfect soil to bury secrets that can't be told.

After the chapter is open, new 5-Star set - Dreamcatcher Talk and 4-Star sets - Breezy Nap/Annie's Hut are ready to craft at Fashion Studio.

Story Quest Chapter 25 Vvanna Challenge will open too!
Clear the stage to obtain 5-Star Earrings - Odd Coexistence, Pose - Sunny Stretch, Photo Frame - Glowing Writing, and more. New 4-Star Dress - Wild Field is also available at Vvanna Shop.


2. New Stellar Fantasy themed furniture will be available at home, including the romantic and mysterious [Nebula Roaming] and [Nebula Dream]. Walk into the radiant galaxy and watch the universe breath around you.

3. Home Gameplay Optimizations
(1) Free Scaling: You can adjust the size of furniture according to your requirements, apply Uniform Scaling on hundreds of pieces, arrange the size and layout in a flexible way to create an ideal space of recreation.
(2) Updated Block Mode: You will be able to adjust the shape of all Blocks by three axes (essentially for Columns and Spheres). Break free from the limitations and embrace the infinite transformation!

4. New Items in Shops
In Glimmer Shop and Inspiration Center, new items are added, including Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Chat Background, Furniture, and more.



[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]

1. Renamed photo scene [Aquarium Adventure] to [Aquarium Adventure - Realm]. Also, we've added another version for this scene named [Aquarium Adventure: Dive]. After this update, we'll send scene [Aquarium Adventure: Dive] to all players who redeemed the scene [Aquarium Adventure - Realm] from Tide Melody decom shop, so that you can use both scenes in photo-shooting. 
2. At Panel, pet poses/poses with pet will appear in pose list when there is a pet with your character. 
3. Fixed the error where owners of pet moms would see a First Generation tag on pet dads in Obstetrics even if the pet dads are not first generation.
4. Fixed the exceptions in pose [Plank] when it's used by adult Samoyed or infant Samoyed during photo-shooting.
5. Fixed incorrect smoke coloration in certain scenes.
6. Fixed the camera display error in some poses.
7. Fixed the failure when posting Fashion Dairy on PC for the first time.
8. Fixed the clipping issues on some fashions and optimized fashion models.
9. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions and pose.
10. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions and furniture.

Notes: All above is only a preview of the coming update. Actual content may vary.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Aug. 14:

1. Pet Outfit
Your pets can be stylish now with the new Pet Outfit function! 

With the new Pet Fashion system, you can dress up your lovely pets as you please! Outfits of various styles have been installed in the outfit collection, and you can tap Fashion button on Pet interface to enter Pet Wardrobe, select the perfect fashions for each body part and dye them freely with Home Chestnuts. Explore the fun of dyeing outfits while you style your pets to be the most dazzling star among their pals! 

In Pet Store - Pet Fashion Store, you can use Home Chestnuts to purchase the first batch of pet outfits. You can also save the outfits for every beloved cutie too. Show the world the beauty of you and your pets! 

2. Optimizations and Updates in Pet System
1) On Pet Family interface, you can tap Background button and change backgrounds using unlocked Scenes. The change will also apply to Pet Store Preview/Adoption Center/Pet Fashion Store, etc. 

2) The number of slots in Pet Foster Care is increased to 18, making it possible for you to grow the pet family.

3. New Story Chapter 24: The Revenge II will open on Aug.19
No one feels safe in the City of Eternal Night, as the punishment of Xie keeps coming.
The truth learned by chance ignited the fire of revenge that lasted for years.
Perhaps somewhere high above the city, a pair of cold eyes is always there. 

After the chapter is open, new 4-Star sets - Heart Roaming/Strawberry Toast/Duckling Class will be ready to make at Fashion Studio.

Story Chapter 24 Vvanna Challenge will open too!
Clear the stages to obtain 5-star Hair Accessory - Eggshell Cone, Pose - Infinite Space, Photo Frame - Dream Album, and many more. New 4-star Top - Half Kiss and Cute Effect - Magic Doll Night are available at Vvanna Shop.

4. New Mind Travel Chapter - Dangerous Game will open on Aug. 19
In a game of manipulation and plots, the reality blends with the play, just as the truth mixes with the lies.

Who's the real murderer? What's hidden under Larry's smile?

After the chapter is open, new 5-star set - Pipe Lion will be ready to craft at Fashion Studio.

5. Change Background for Friend Chats
Time to bring new colors to the chats! In Friends > Chat > Chat Details, you can tap Background to select from obtained chat backgrounds and set separately for each chat.

6. New Items in Rebate Shop
1) New pet breed - British Shorthair Tabby is available in Deluxe Rebates. Unique stripes and patterns on their coat makes tabby cats dignified and mysterious. Don't miss them, cat-lovers!
2) In Value Rebates, Special Rebates, and Super Rebates, new items are added including new Pose - Confident/Full Score, Pet Dog Dynamic Pose - Tearful, Pet Cat Dynamic Pose - Shouting Journal. Redeem your favored ones!

7. Rebate Level Extended
Starting from Rebate Lv. 33 - Destined Pact, you can unlock and claim newly added Rebate Fashions: Gorgeous 6-star set - Luminous Wings, 5-star set - Song of Shepherd, pet cat fashion - Layered Honey/Egg Roll Princess, pet dog fashion - Sunny Library/Puppy's Throne, scene - Boating Rain, dynamic pose, dynamic chat bubble, dynamic chat background, dynamic avatar frame, advanced effect title and many more.

8. New&Limited Qixi Recipe

Studio Mode is coming soon to Panel, allowing for a wider scale and freer camera view. Showcase your beauty from every possible angle!
