notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Jul. 24:
 
[New Features]
 
1. New Rewards at Rebate Shops
New 5-star set - Yard Blossom is added in Deluxe Rebates, new 5-star hairstyle - Pink Cloud Fairy is added in Super Rebates, new 5-star hair accessory - Glaze Silk and 5-star handheld - Solitary Patrol are added in Special Rebates, new 4-star wrist accessory - Preset Trail and 4-star earrings - Atlas Daze are added in Value Rebates. Pose, dynamic pet pose, avatar, furniture, chat bubble, and more appearances await!
 
2. New Candy-like Paper-Art Themed Furniture
Candy-art themed furniture is available at Home > Build. Purchase lovely pieces such as Paper-Folding Dream and Childhood Journey to decorate your house into a lively and fairytale-like world, and listen to the candy whispers left by the stars.
 
3. Fashion Battle - Fashion Monthly Cover
Cover System is added for Fashion Battle > Fashion Monthly. Dream Makers who are featured in Fashion Monthly can take photos and upload their Monthly cover to show their best selves.
 
[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
 
1. Optimized part of the Pet Diary texts.
2. Fixed the issue where the pet model performance turns abnormal when changing camera distance while purchasing pets.
3. Fixed the clipping issues on some fashions and optimized fashion models.
4. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions and furniture.
5. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions and poses.
6. Fixed the camera display error in some poses.
7. Fixed the assisting frame display errors when using Aspect Ratio function for Fashion Diary cover shooting.
 
Note: All above is a preview of the upcoming update. Actual game content may vary.
 

Preview
 
1. New Story Chapter 24 Coming Soon: The Revenge II
No one feels safe in the City of Eternal Night, as the punishment of Xie keeps coming.
The truth learned by chance ignited the fire of revenge that lasted for years.
Perhaps somewhere high above the city, a pair of cold eyes is always there. 

After the chapter is open, new 4-Star sets will be ready to make at Fashion Studio.
 
2. Pet Wefie Coming Soon
Wouldn't it be great if you can not only let pets of you and your friends' play together, but also take photos for them?

In Photo - For Pet, Pet Wefie will be available soon, where you can invite friends' pets to take a wefie with your pets. Select positions and poses for each of them and splash the magic of photography!
 
3. More Updates and Optimizations in Pet System
Background Change is going to be available in Pet interface. You can use all the unlocked photo Scenes to find the perfect fit for your furry friends. The pets are also getting a ton of new dynamic poses and interactions. These lively little legends are going to bring even more joy and laughter to the world in Life Makeover. So come join your adorable pets in creating some unforgettable memories!
 
4. Limited-time Reruns of Previous Events
Still thinking about that free piece you missed a while ago? 
The reruns are about to come soon! Limited free fashions and appearances are available again, make sure to get them this time!

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Jul. 3:

[New Features]
1. Vvanna Community: Topic System
Topic System is coming to Vvanna Community. Join the topic discussion to make more people see your content and find friends with similar interests! View the on-going topics at Friends > Community > Topic.

2. Fashion Diary: Data Share and Dye Import
In the upgraded Fashion Diary, you will be able to share your OOTD outside the game. Shared Fashion Diaries have unique series numbers and can be imported directly at Wardrobe and Dye interfaces with all the dye data including X Starlight plans. Show more people your dress-up talents and fabulous dyes! OOTD Code can be imported at Wardrobe > Import or Dye > Import.

3. Optimizations and Updates in Pet System
1) At Home, when pets are interacting with furniture - they can be sleeping or eating - you can build and decorate as usual. No need to wake up the sleeping cuties any more!
2) Pet wandering range is expanded. Your pets will show up at any corner, from sun-basking in rooms up high to wilding their nature in lawns outdoor. Prepare to have a pleasant surprise meeting your pets.
3) Like Function is available. Saw a pet star and wanted to send your love and support? The Like function is here to help! When viewing shared pets from other players, you can like the pet as a gesture of admiration. Your pet may also be the next pet star!
4) Pet Diary has been updated with new discoveries of the cuties.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. New dye areas #6-15 are added for dress [Flower Whisper] in permanent Lightchase. More enhancements for dye areas of other fashion pieces are on the way.
2. New dye areas #5-12 are added for dress [Secret Garden] in Rebate Exchange. More enhancements for dye areas of other fashion pieces are on the way. 
3. Thunder strike experience is available in Home Weather System. An adventure with thunder strikes is available at Home, which brings you a chance to be struck by the thunder when you are at Home during a stormy day. The feature is accessible on the latest game version. It's advised to update to the latest version from our official website, App Store, or Google Play in order to experience this feature.
4. Optimized some fashions' models. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions, fashions and poses, and fashions and furniture. 
5. Fixed the camera display error in some poses.

Notes: All above is a preview of the upcoming new features. Actual content may vary.


Preview

1. Pet Wefie Coming Soon
Wouldn't it be great if you can not only let pets of you and your friends' play together, but also take photos for them?

In Photo - Pet Photo, Pet Wefie will be available soon, where you can invite friends' pets to take a wefie with your pets. Select positions and poses for each of them and splash the magic of photography!

2. More Updates and Optimizations in Pet System
Background Change is going to be available in Pet interface. You can use all the unlocked photo Scenes to find the perfect fit for your furry friends. The pets are also getting a ton of new dynamic poses and interactions. These lively little legends are going to bring even more joy and laughter to the world in Life Makeover. So come join your adorable pets in creating some unforgettable memories!

3. Limited-time Reruns of Previous Events & Rewards
Still thinking about that free piece you missed a while ago? 
The reruns are about to come soon! Limited free fashions and appearances are available again, make sure to get them this time!

Illusion made up of truth and lies reflects the figure of the familiar.
Memories are a dangerous trap. An escape is the only key to the ultimate truth.
The war among "detectives" is about to break out. What does it cost to win the key to truth?

2. New and Upgraded Photo System: Studio Mode Part One
In Studio Mode, you can break free from the camera limitations in basic photo mode. Close-up or far off, the camera is at your call.

Rotate the camera to every angle, look up or down as you want.
Present magnificent views with panorama lens, illustrate intense images with optimal perspective.
Tilt the camera for creativity, diversity, and beauty.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New Features and Optimizations after the update on May 1:
  
[New Features]
1. The Pet System is Ready to Bring You a Cyber Experience with Pets!
 
The Pet System has arrived, and it's absolutely adorable! Through  high-fidelity simulation technology, we've faithfully recreated the intricate details of real-life pets!
 
In the highly free pet customization system, there are over 50 customizable features, highly free adjustable parameters, 4 character options, and every little details including even the "bells" and paw pads. It's designed to make you meet your cute baby that's uniquely yours from inside out! 
 
Meanwhile, in Photo, [For Pet] mode and [With Pet] mode are added! In [For Pet] mode, you are the exclusive photographer for your pets and the commander-in-chief for their loveliness. Take photos for one or two pets for the best shot of cuteness! In [With Pet] mode, you can take photos with your pets to record all the beautiful moments of companionship and mutual healing. 
 
More surprises and hidden gameplay are waiting to be explored. Dream Makers, come and experience the fun!
 
Every effort we made was to bring you unparalleled realistic pet raising experience!
    
2. The [Tail Realm] Set's Tail [Nine-Life Flame] Has a Third Style
A fluffy style of Tail - Nine-Life Flame in Set - Tail Realm is available, and now you can switch the tail among three different styles. 
 
In the mean time, we've also optimized the set collection pose - Tangled Soul's movements and prolonged the pose as well as the background music. Looking forward to seeing more stunning photos you make with it!
   
3. New Story Chapter 21: Ticket to Sin - Chain will open on May 1
"Welcome to the Tarot Amusement Park and join the online adventure of fun and excitement. However, not everyone is qualified for the game.
Losers will be punished a bit... After all, a game is only interesting with both winners and losers."
A detective game with unexpected dangers. And why does the gaze from that strange ID looks so familiar...
 
After the chapter is open, new 5-star set - Confined Kiss, 4-star set - Aged Harbor/Lotus Sip will be ready to craft at Fashion Studio.
 
Story Chapter 21 Vvanna Challenge will be open too!
Clear the stage to get 5-star Hat - White Bay, Pose - Half Screen, and Cute Effect - Introvert Frog. You can also redeem 5-star Dress - Aroma Bath and Dynamic Photo Frame - Luminous Dream at Vvanna Shop.
  
  
[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized the adulthood and infant stage performance for Golden Retrievers.
2. Fixed the abnormal shimmering on the back of set - Tail Realm.
3. Fixed the clipping models when wearing dress - Icy Glamour or dress - Stellar Trails with some socks.
4. Fixed the jittering error in the ribbons around the hands of dress - Icy Glamour.
5. Optimized the metal and gemstone performance of the dress Lord of Abyss.
6. Optimized the physical effects for necklace Abyssal Shackles and also fixed its missing shadow.
7. Fixed the problem of incomplete wrist display when the dress Lord of Abyss is paired with gloves Dawn Commander and coat Chubby Sleeptalk. Optimized the metal and gemstone performance of the dress Lord of Abyss.
8. Optimized the physical effects for necklace Abyssal Shackles and also fixed its missing shadow.
9. Optimized the physical effects of the fringes of the dress Sparrow Chirp.
10. Optimized the adaptation performance on custom waists for dress Crisp Peach.
11. Optimized the lens movement range in the photo scene Neon Soundwave, allowing the camera to be pulled further when taking photos in this scene.
12. Fixed the pose display errors for pose Gentleman's Date/Getting Ready.
13. Fixed the issue with display when changing handheld item for pose Dream Aura.
14. Fixed the issue of fences unable to overlay with furniture in Advanced Build mode.
15. Fixed the hidden wall surface when copying walls in Advanced Build mode.
16. Optimized the model for some fashions, fixed the clipping issue between some fashions, fashions and poses, and fashions and furniture.
   
   
Note: All above is a preview of the upcoming new features. Actual content may vary.
  
  
    
Preview
  
1. Fashion Diary: Data Share and Dye Import
Make better use of your exquisite styling and share to your friends outside the game. 
 
In the upgraded Fashion Diary, you will be able to share your OOTD outside the game. Shared Fashion Diaries have unique series numbers and can be imported directly at Wardrobe with all the dye data including Starlight plans. Show more people your dress-up talents and fabulous dyes!
  
2. Studio Mode & Aspect Ratio for Photo System
In the coming optimizations for photo system, studio mode and frame adjustment functions will be available!
 
In studio mode, you can break free from the limitation on lens range in basic photo mode and admire all the details in every corner of the scenes. From the trendy top view to the handy tilt camera to the stylish panorama, everything will be possible!
 
Meanwhile, multiple picture sizes will be added too, such as square photos suitable for social platforms, story-telling screen-sized photos, and portrait photos. Get ready for the freed and enhanced experience in photo-shooting!

Still thinking about that free piece you missed a while ago? 
The reruns are about to come soon! Limited free fashions and appearances are available again, make sure to get them this time!

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New Features and Optimizations after the update on Apr. 10:

[New Features]
1. New Mind Travel Chapter - Note Password will open on Apr. 18
In the maze cast out of memories hides the key to private regrets.
Cold numbers ring a vague bell. The answer is only known to Roy...

After the chapter is open, new 5-Star Set - Rime-Clad Satin will be available to make at Fashion Studio.

2. Set-Exclusive Hair Accessory – Blooming Flame Made More Inclusive 
The Hair Accessory – Blooming Flame in set – Tail Realm is optimized specially, so that exclusive parts that only display on the set’s Hairstyle - Unexpected Dream can also be worn on other hairstyles.

When wearing it on other hairstyles, its exclusive parts are invisible by default. You can turn them to visible and change their positions from Wardrobe > Headwear Position.

More set exclusive hair accessories will be optimized in the coming versions. Stay tuned.

3. New Arrivals in Shops
New items are added in Convenience Store and Rebate Shop: Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Avatar, Furniture, and more.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Vvanna Quiz is updated with more questions. Check out how well you know the world of Life Makeover in the challenges!
2. Fixed the deshaped beads on the back of the dress - Fluffy Love.
3. Fixed the clipping model of gems on dress - Fluffy Love.
4. Fixed the missing fabrics when changing from dress - Fluffy Love into dress - Clockwork Heart.
5. Fixed the display effect errors when using a handheld item with Fluffy Love's special standing posture.
6. Fixed the abnormal jitterings when zooming in the camera on dress - Iris Scepter.
7. Fixed the display errors for some poses in front of the camera.
8. Fixed the leg display errors for some poses.
9. Fixed the ineffective DOF effect for some poses.
10. Fixed the missing embroidery on coat - Suave Move's sleeves at Home.
11. Fixed the clipping models between some fashions and furniture at Home.
12. Fixed the navigating issue that character can't reach cabinets with furniture placed on them when cooking at Home.
13. Fixed the possible issue of not being able to receive Energy gifts from friends.
14. Fixed the issue that system notifications may display when shooting a Fashion Diary cover.
15. Fixed the possible issue that blocked players can still send you messages.

Notes: All above is a preview of the upcoming new version. Actual content may vary.

Preview

1. Vvanna Community: Topic System
Topic System is coming to Vvanna Community. Join the topic discussion to make more people see your content and find friends with similar interests!

2. Enhanced Photo at Wardrobe & Home
Photo-taking experience will be greatly enhanced, where there will be no limit to the camera lens and more handy tools for you to adjust view and image structure. We hope this new and freed photo experience will bring you a special and unique way to appreciate the world in Life Makeover and capture moments that catch your heart.

3. Pet System
Have you ever thought about having a pet? They bring you companion, warmth, joy, and many things you could not imagine. If the answer is yes, then your wish is about to come true in Life Makeover!

Enjoy the unique pet raising experience where you get to own your exclusive pet, cuddle intimately with them, take photos for them, and see how amazing the breed variation can be! 

Prepare yourself for a world with pets and joy!

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New Features and Optimizations after the update on Feb. 28:


1. New Cyber-Style Furniture
Cyber-fantasy furniture is added in Home, including music chair, time-space doors and windows, etc. New light band with futuristic design is ready to connect your house with the future world.


2. Wefie Sync
Want to have a coordinated performance with your friends on the stage? Check out Wefie Sync function!
When using the same Dynamic Pose, check the sync option to coordinate the timing and speed. This function is available for Wefies of both friends and your own image slots!


3. Preview Avatar Frame
It's never too much to want to have a perfect avatar with a beautifully-fit avatar frame at one go. 
Use the Preview function when taking selfies for your avatar to see if the current Avatar Frame is the best choice. 


4. Enhanced Private Image Data
We've optimized privacy rules for private Image Data so that they won't appear in search results and can't be imported either.


5. New Story Chapter 19 - Sin under the Aurora III will be Live on Feb. 28
The unsolved missing case, and even more accidents to come.
Accusations, confrontation... The fire of war is at its tipping point.
On the sailing curse under the aurora, will there be more secrets to be revealed?
After the chapter is unlocked, new 5-star set - Flower Language and 4-star set - Crescent Apricot/Golden Sand will be available to make in Fashion Studio.


VVANNA Challenge Chapter 19 will be Live As Well! 
After clearing the stages, you can get 5-Star Earrings - Surrounding Stars, Pose - Shade Breeze, Photo Frame - Heart Party and other rewards. Meanwhile, 5-Star Handheld - Graceful Phantom and Photo Frame - Dazzling Memory will be added in VVANNA exchange shop. 


6. Sign-in Collection - Rhythm of Sea
Rhythm of Sea from previous sign-in rewards will be available to make on Mar. 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.


7. New4-Star Makeup Set - Fantasy Wonderland is available at Guild Beauty Course.


8. New Items in Shops
In Ally Shop and Rebate Shop, new items are added, including Furniture, Pose, Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Avatar, etc.


[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized display performance for some fashions.
2.Optimized the logic of selecting Allies for Quick Deploy.
3. Optimized the interface performance on Brand Activities if Popularity reaches the highest.
4. Optimized the display of the Level EXP bar in the interface of completing Raid x10 at Story stages and the EXP bar of Cooking Proficiency.
5. Fixed the issue that when switching from System Avatar page to History Avatar page, Avatar names are wrongly displayed as Custom Avatar.
6. Fixed the issue that the highest available custom resolution rate on some devices is only 1080p.


-----------------------


<Coming Soon>


1. Main Page BGM Customization
Want to pick a perfect background music for your Panel styling and pose?
The Main Page BGM Customization is coming soon! Classic, pops, jazz, light music, you name it! Play multiple pieces on shuffle or at your favored order if you want to!


2. Vvanna Community: Topic System
Topic System is coming to Vvanna Community. Join the topic discussion to make more people see your content and find friends with similar interests!


3. Enhanced Photo at Wardrobe & Home
Photo-taking experience will be greatly enhanced, where there will be no limit to the camera lens and more handy tools for you to adjust view and image structure. We hope this new and freed photo experience will bring you a special and unique way to appreciate the world in Life Makeover and capture moments that catch your heart.


Note: All above is a preview of the upcoming new features. As for the final content, please refer to in-game details.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Feb. 1:

[New Features]
1. New Mind Travel Chapter - Mansion Secrets will open on Feb. 21
In the remote old village, an ancient ancestral hall is haunted.
Is greed behind the story, or is there something else?
Faced with the expectant villagers and the determined sister, how will Shawn make the decision?

After the chapter is unlocked, new items will be available at Fashion Studio, including 5-Star Set - Cherry Cocoa, SR Ally - Heartbeat Primary, 4-Star Makeup Set - Tipsy Spring Breeze, and many photo resources. 

2. Wefie Updates: Image Slot Mode, Video Mode, Offline Mode
The fun at Wefie knows no bounds.
In Wefie > Image Slot, free your cyber images and make them meet each other! Tap Select Image at Invite page to select from the saved ones to take photos with your current image. You can also style them with different Fashions, Handhelds, Poses, and Cute Effects!

Moreover, you can make videos with friends together and invite offline friends for Wefies. Have fun making thrilling duet content!

3. Custom Avatar History 
Want to keep all your stunning selfie avatars? The Avatar History function is coming soon!
Up to 10 recently used custom avatars will be automatically saved in Avatar History, so that you can change them back whenever you want!

4. Home DOF on Mobile
Want to try the delicate PC Home DOF effect on mobile devices? We heard you! Switch to Follow Mode at Home and zoom in the camera on the characters to feel the difference. You can also turn it off any time from Settings.

5. Clear Cache
You can turn on the Clear Cache function at Settings and clear in-game images and video cache automatically or manually. Please follow our future notice for function open time.

6. New PC Shortcuts
New shortcuts are available on PC, including skipping animation, confirming or canceling general pop-up windows, claiming Endorsement Queen income, etc. 

7. New Items in Shops
In Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Rebate Shop, new items are added, including Furniture, Pose, Cute Effect, Photo Frame, Chat Deco, etc.

8. Brand Gallery Level Reward is expanded to Lv. 37 with more rewards for fashion collecting.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized appearance performance for some fashions.
2. Red packets triggered in limited Lightchase events can be muted now. Enable the function and you will not see the Red Packet icon on main page once you claim all the daily claimable packets.
3. On PC, you can switch screen display mode for Photo, Home, and Home Photo respectively without changing the overall game display when exiting the functions.
4. New Title rewards are available by interacting in Vvanna Community.
5. Ally Shard exchange cap is expanded so that exchanging for more Ally Shards is easier.
6. Dye part #3 is added for Handheld - Falling Rain so that you can dye the umbrella surface.

Note: All above is a preview of the upcoming new features. As for the final content, please refer to in-game details.

Coming Soon
1. Vvanna Community: Topic System
Topic System is coming to Vvanna Community. Join the topic discussion to make more people see your content and find friends with similar interests!

2. Wefie Dynamic Pose Sync 
Want to have a coordinated performance with your friends on the stage?
Wefie Sync is coming to help realize your dream! When using the same Dynamic Pose, you can use the function to sync the pose timing for both of the characters and produce identical visual effects!

3. New Story Chapter 19 - Sin under the Aurora III
The unsolved missing case, and even more accidents to come.
Accusations, confrontation... The fire of war is at its tipping point.
On the sailing curse under the aurora, will there be more secrets to be revealed?

After the chapter is unlocked, new 5-star and 4-star sets will be available to make in Fashion Studio.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Jan. 17：
[New Features]
  
1. Vvanna Community
Vvanna Community will be open shortly after the version update!
Here you will be able to follow the latest in-game trends, learn about how experienced players style/build houses/design fashions, show your talents, and join various discussions. 
This is a place you belong! Please follow the coming announcement for official open time.
  
2. Two-Person Photo Mode
Tap Wefie button on the Photo interface to invite friends for a Wefie.
You can pick suitable Poses, Cute Effects, and Two-Person Poses for both of you. Have fun making stunning group photos!
  
3. Dynamic Pose Speed Control
Want to adjust speed when playing Dynamic Poses? Here comes the Speed function!
When playing Dynamic Poses in Photo interface, you can change the speed with the Speed slide bar to experiment with different tempo! In Panel, you can also use a Speed slide bar by tapping the Speed button, and save the speed change to the Main Page.
  
4. Occupational Furniture
Build different workplace scenes with medical equipment, teacher's desk, blackboard, and more furniture at Home. It's time for some renovation, role-play, and fun!
  
5. Immersive Rain on PC
For Home on PC, new experience with the rain is added: When it's heavy rain or thunderstorm and you are outside, you can see raindrops flowing down your skin, and your tresses of hair and dress getting soaked. You can also turn off the rain effect from Home Settings. Enjoy the immersive experience brought by the rain!
  
6. Horizontal/Vertical Home Photo Switch
When taking photos at Home, you can switch between Horizontal and Vertical view without having to exit Photo Mode first.
  
7. Sign-in Collection - Blooming Sakura
Previous sign-in reward - Blooming Sakura will be available to craft on Dec. 1 at Design Room > Fashion Studio > Sign-in Collection.
  
8. Guild Beauty Course updated with new 4-Star Makeup Sets - Stormy Forest/Night Scroll.
  
9. New Arrivals at Shop
New items are added in Glimmer Shop, Inspiration Center, and Ally Shop including new Pose, Photo Frame, Cute Effect, Avatar, Furniture, Chat Decoration, and many more.

[Optimizations and Bugfixes]
  
1. Optimized appearance performance for some fashions.
2. Decom Bench button is added on fashion dye making page so that decomposing repeated crafted fashions becomes more convenient.
3. Optimized progress bar performance and level name when current Fashion Style Points exceed SSS. This optimization is only an adjustment on UI and does not affect actual numbers.
4. ESC shortcut is enabled for closing pop-up windows on PC.
5. A new Dye Part #5 is added for Dress - Cocoa Hearts so that you can dye its bandeau pattern.

[Coming Soon]

1. Custom Avatar History
Want to keep all your stunning selfie avatars? The Avatar History function is coming soon!
Recently used custom avatars will be automatically saved in Avatar History, so that you can change them back whenever you want!
  
2. New Mind Travel Chapter -  Mansion Secrets
In the remote old village, an ancient ancestral hall is haunted.
Is greed behind the story, or is there something else?
Faced with the expectant villagers and the determined sister, how will Shawn make the decision?
After the chapter is unlocked, new 5-Star set will be available in Fashion Studio. 
  
3. New Fashion Battle Season - Eden Date
Fashion Battle - Eden Date is coming soon. New 6-Star and 5-Star Sets, Makeup, Photo Items, Avatars and many other rewards are arriving at Fashion Shop!

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Dec. 22:
[New Features]
1.Save Camera Parameter on Scene Change
In the improved Photo function, camera and character position will be saved when you switch Scenes. Feel "free" for real this time to browse all the backgrounds and poses because you don't have to readjust character or camera angle every time!
2.Home Photo Pose Auto Sync
Too much trouble syncing poses to your friends every time you take photos with them at Home?
Instead of syncing poses manually, other players can now see it simultaneously when you change Poses, Expressions, and Handhelds in Home Photo.
You can also disable the auto-sync from Home Photo Settings and enjoy photo time alone.
3.Save Daily Share Outfits
Wanna save the outfit that you style for everyday Share themes? Use Save Outfit function!
Tap the Save button on the Daily Share page to save the outfit to your custom outfit column and use in Wardrobe at the same time. Capture every moment of your creative styling!
4.Rewards for Level 130 are added, including Furniture, Pose, Cute Effects, Photo Frame, Title, and many other items.
5.Claim All function is added in Daily Missions and now you can take all the mission rewards in one go!
6. New Story Chapter - Sin under the Aurora II will be live on Jan. 3
Hidden murderer, missing crews,
Black-out, losing contact, devil triangle...
The storm is accumulating under the aurora. Where will the cruise of sin be heading?
After the chapter is unlocked, new 4-Star sets Cinnamon Tea/Bye-bye South/Cocoa Hearts can be made in Fashion Studio.

VVANNA Challenge Chapter 18 will be alive as well! 
After clearing the stages, you can get 5-Star fashion piece - Lightchase Youth, Pose - Look Afar, Photo Frame - Standby Screen and other rewards. Meanwhile, 4-Star Outfit Pinky Date and Cute Effect - Shiny Kitten will be added in VVANNA exchange shop. 
7. Sign-in Collection - Vibrant Girl
Vibrant Girl from previous sign-in rewards will be available to make on Jan. 1. You can find it at Design Room - Fashion Studio - Sign-in Collection.

[Optimizations and Bug Fixes]
1. Optimized display performance for some fashion appearances.
2. More Poses are made available for [Focus] option.
3. In Photo, server-wide notifications will be blocked automatically so that you can enjoy an immersive time taking photos.
4. New Guild position names are added for Guild members.
5. New Dye Part #3 is added for Handheld - Galaxy Of Gem so that you can dye the starlight effects on the globe. Meanwhile the wrong dyeing effect on the Handheld's Dye Part #2 has also been fixed.

Note: All above is a preview of the upcoming new features. As for the final content, please refer to in-game details.


Coming Soon
1. Two-Person Photo Mode: Wefie
In Wefie, you can invite friends to take photos together. Pick outfits and poses for both of you, or use two-person poses together. Have fun building up friendship and making beautiful photos!
2. Dynamic Pose Play Speed
You will be able to adjust the speed of Dynamic Poses in both Photo and Panel. Bring out new charm in your long-familiar poses!
3. Custom Avatar History
Want to keep all your stunning selfie avatars? The Avatar History function is coming soon!
Recently used custom avatars will be automatically saved in Avatar History, so that you can change them back whenever you want!
4. Immersive Rain on PC
To make it feel more realistic when you are at home on PC version, we are introducing the new experience of getting wet in the rain: When it's raining heavily or thunder storming and you are outside of the house, you will find raindrops flowing down your skin, and the fabric of your outfits and your tresses of hair will be soaked by rain. Wash your troubles away in the rain! Of course, you can always say no to the new experience with rain by turning it off in Home - Rain Settings.

notes.title: Version Update
notes.content:
New features and optimizations after the update on Dec. 6:
[New Features]
1. Wind Power for Photo, Wardrobe, and Panel
Want to see how it feels to have your hair and dress sway with the wind in photos? In addition to the home wind system, photo wind system is also available. Custom wind direction/power when taking photos, and apply the settings to Wardrobe and main page if you want. You can also set up main page wind effect independently in Panel!
2. Chinese Courtyard Furniture & Food Furniture
New Chinese style courtyard furniture is available in Home Build. Build your own private yard with authentic Chinese walls and delicate rockery. New flower and grass plants are also available!
Meanwhile, food decorations are added to the collection to make your house both artistic and vigorous!
3. Search Furniture and Locate Character
Use Filter function which is located at Home - Build to find the furniture you want quickly.
Meanwhile, when in Unfollow Mode, you can tap Locate Me button which can be found at Home - bottom left Avatar to shift and focus the camera at your character. No more getting-lost in your big house!
4. Photo Sharpening&Halo Adjust
Sharpening function is added in Wardrobe Photo - Retouch to help you adjust the photo sharpening with a slider bar and make the image definition right to the point. Moreover, the Blooming function is renamed into Halo, with newly added scale slider which is separated from intensity slider, making it possible to create different vibes using the same scene.
5. Full-screen View for Exclusive Design
When making DYI fashions, it will be more convenient to look at them in a full-screen view. We've made it possible by providing Collapse function that can put away the drawing panel for you.  View your fashion details closer with one click.

The isolated stormy mountain is home to the secret fountain. The water is running away among the conspiracies.

4. Exclusive entering pose - Hymn to Irises for Set - Iris Scepter has been optimized. Pose-exclusive dynamic camera has also been available at Photo - Dynamic Pose.
5. Optimized Dress - Iris Scepter's appearance performance. Dye Parts #6 - #8 are added together with new fashion effects, where you can dye the Starlight effects for both of the two layers on the hem. Meanwhile, Dye Part #5 is added for Handheld - Rights of Irises, and you can also dye its special effects.
6. Simplified style switch operation for Dress - Iris Scepter. Instead of having to open the fashion detail page, you can now tap the switch button on the fashion thumbnail to switch between two styles.
